meta.name: data-modeling
meta.description: Designs the warehouse and semantic layer — source-to-mart structure, dimensional modeling, grain, slowly changing dimensions, and the metric layer analytics reads through. Use this to design or restructure a warehouse, model a new source, decide on grain or table structure, build a semantic or metric layer, or diagnose why queries are slow, wrong, or impossible to write.

copy.tagline: 设计支撑业务分析的数据模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你负责搭建或重构公司的数据仓库。
copy.tagline_en: Design a data warehouse model that supports analytics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are responsible for building or redesigning a company's data warehouse.

howto.what: Claude 会先定各表粒度（一行代表什么），按原始/暂存/集市三层设计数据仓库，区分事实与维度，统一语义层指标，并遵守不直接在原始层建集市、不混粒度等规则。
howto.when: 当要求设计/重构数仓、建模新数据源等数据建模工作，或诊断查询慢、错、无法编写时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计数据仓库，按原始/暂存/集市三层来规划。
say.note: Claude 会按三层方法论输出结构。

say.text: 这个订单事实表，一行代表一个订单行一天，粒度这样定对吗？
say.note: Claude 会评估粒度并说明对下游求和的影响。

say.text: 两个报表的同一指标对不上，我是不是漏建了语义层？
say.note: Claude 会从语义层/指标定义角度帮查根因。

howto.what_en: Claude states each table's grain, designs layers (raw/staging/marts), separates facts and dimensions, unifies metrics in the semantic layer, and obeys rules such as no marts on raw and no mixed grains.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to design/restructure a warehouse, model a new source, or diagnose why queries are slow, wrong, or impossible to write.

say_en.text: Help me design a warehouse by planning raw/staging/mart layers.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a three-layer structure.

say_en.text: Is the grain 'one row per order line per day' right for this order fact table?
say_en.note: Claude will assess grain and query impact.

say_en.text: Two reports disagree on the same metric—did I skip the semantic layer?
say_en.note: Claude will trace it through the metric definitions.
